title: Top K Frequent Elements

monster.name: Frequency Behemoth
monster.title: Counter of Occurrences
monster.defeatQuote: Bucket sort and heaps exposed the top k frequencies!

description: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k` most frequent elements in descending order of frequency.
constraints: k is in range [1, unique elements]
starterCode:
def topKFrequent(nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def topKFrequent(nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(nums)
    sorted_items = sorted(counts.keys(), key=lambda x: -counts[x])
    return sorted_items[:k]
hints: Count frequencies, then use a heap or bucket sort to extract top k.
